title: Composition and Tate action on rational homomorphisms
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], and $A,B,C$ abelian varieties over $k$ [def-sc-abelian-variety]. Write $H(A,B)$ for the abelian group of group-scheme homomorphisms $A\to B$ [def-sc-group-scheme], with pointwise addition, and use the rational homomorphisms [def-sfb-abelian-rational-hom] $H^0(A,B)=\mathbf Q\otimes_{\mathbf Z}H(A,B)$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], canonically identified with $H(A,B)\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathbf Q$ by interchanging the factors. The integral inclusion sends $f$ to $1\otimes f$. Precomposition and postcomposition by integral homomorphisms are extended by scalar extension to $H^0$. For a prime $\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], the componentwise Tate action [sk-def-av-tate] extends to $H^0(A,B)$ by $q\otimes f\mapsto qV_\ell(f)$, with $q$ acting through the canonical embedding $\mathbf Q\to\mathbf Q_\ell$. Thus this construction specifies actual maps between the rational Tate modules, rather than arbitrary actions.

source.place: Chapter I §10, pp.45–46 (Hom and rational Hom; componentwise Tate action), and §14, printed p.61 (rational inverse in Hom(A dual,A) tensor Q).
